details: The package's preinstall hook (node setup.mjs) downloads the Bun JavaScript runtime from github[.]com/oven-sh/bun and then executes a bundled 727KB heavily-obfuscated file (math_init.js) with it. The obfuscated payload uses a custom string-decoding scheme over a large dictionary array, concealing its behaviour from static analysis. A React grid component has no legitimate reason to download a runtime and run a large obfuscated payload at install time; this is a multi-stage dropper that executes attacker-controlled code during installation.
